meta: What does AI do on farms and in factories? Drones find sick rice, cameras spot defects on the conveyor belt, and AI listens to machines to warn before they break.

muc.title: A drone finds sick rice
muc.text: A drone flies over a field, and AI points to the exact patch of rice that's sick.

muc.title: Spray only where needed
muc.text: AI compares leaf colors across thousands of photos and marks the sick areas, so farmers spray only where needed instead of the whole field.

muc.title: Cameras check every product
muc.text: In factories, cameras with AI check every product on the conveyor belt, finding scratches or crooked caps faster than human eyes.

muc.title: Listening to machines to predict breakdowns
muc.text: AI also listens to how machines vibrate and warns before one breaks, so technicians can fix it in time and the whole line doesn't have to stop.

muc.title: Snap a leaf and ask AI
muc.text: Take a photo of a wilting leaf from a plant at home, send it to a chatbot to ask why, then check with someone experienced at growing plants.
